      if (this._writing) {
        return;
      }
      if (this._bufs.length === 0) {
        this._bufs.push([]);
        this._lens.push(0);
      }
      this._actualWrite();
    }
    SonicBoom.prototype.reopen = function(file) {
      if (this.destroyed) {
        throw new Error("SonicBoom destroyed");
      }
      if (this._opening) {
        this.once("ready", () => {
          this.reopen(file);
        });
        return;
      }
      if (this._ending) {
        return;
      }
      if (!this.file) {
        throw new Error("Unable to reopen a file descriptor, you must pass a file to SonicBoom");
      }
      if (file) {
        this.file = file;
      }
      this._reopening = true;
      if (this._writing) {
        return;
      }
      const fd = this.fd;
      this.once("ready", () => {
        if (fd !== this.fd) {
          fs.close(fd, (err) => {
            if (err) {
              return this.emit("error", err);
            }
          });
        }
      });
      openFile(this.file, this);
    };
    SonicBoom.prototype.end = function() {
      if (this.destroyed) {
        throw new Error("SonicBoom destroyed");
      }
      if (this._opening) {
        this.once("ready", () => {
          this.end();
        });
        return;
      }
      if (this._ending) {
        return;
      }
      this._ending = true;
      if (this._writing) {
        return;
      }
      if (this._len > 0 && this.fd >= 0) {
        this._actualWrite();
      } else {
        actualClose(this);
      }
    };
    function flushSync() {
      if (this.destroyed) {
        throw new Error("SonicBoom destroyed");
      }
      if (this.fd < 0) {
        throw new Error("sonic boom is not ready yet");
      }
      if (!this._writing && this._writingBuf.length > 0) {
        this._bufs.unshift(this._writingBuf);
        this._writingBuf = "";
      }
      let buf = "";
      while (this._bufs.length || buf.length) {
        if (buf.length <= 0) {
          buf = this._bufs[0];
        }
        try {
          const n = Buffer.isBuffer(buf) ? fs.writeSync(this.fd, buf) : fs.writeSync(this.fd, buf, "utf8");
          const releasedBufObj = releaseWritingBuf(buf, this._len, n);
          buf = releasedBufObj.writingBuf;
          this._len = releasedBufObj.len;
          if (buf.length <= 0) {
            this._bufs.shift();
          }
        } catch (err) {
          const shouldRetry = err.code === "EAGAIN" || err.code === "EBUSY";
          if (shouldRetry && !this.retryEAGAIN(err, buf.length, this._len - buf.length)) {
            throw err;
          }
          sleep(BUSY_WRITE_TIMEOUT);
        }
      }
      try {
        fs.fsyncSync(this.fd);
      } catch {
      }
    }
    function flushBufferSync() {
      if (this.destroyed) {
        throw new Error("SonicBoom destroyed");
      }
      if (this.fd < 0) {
        throw new Error("sonic boom is not ready yet");
      }
      if (!this._writing && this._writingBuf.length > 0) {
        this._bufs.unshift([this._writingBuf]);
        this._writingBuf = kEmptyBuffer;
      }
      let buf = kEmptyBuffer;
      while (this._bufs.length || buf.length) {
        if (buf.length <= 0) {
          buf = mergeBuf(this._bufs[0], this._lens[0]);
        }
        try {
          const n = fs.writeSync(this.fd, buf);
          buf = buf.subarray(n);
          this._len = Math.max(this._len - n, 0);
          if (buf.length <= 0) {
            this._bufs.shift();
            this._lens.shift();
          }
        } catch (err) {
          const shouldRetry = err.code === "EAGAIN" || err.code === "EBUSY";
          if (shouldRetry && !this.retryEAGAIN(err, buf.length, this._len - buf.length)) {
            throw err;
          }
          sleep(BUSY_WRITE_TIMEOUT);
        }
      }
    }
    SonicBoom.prototype.destroy = function() {
      if (this.destroyed) {
        return;
      }
      actualClose(this);
    };
    function actualWrite() {
      const release = this.release;
      this._writing = true;
      this._writingBuf = this._writingBuf.length ? this._writingBuf : this._bufs.shift() || "";
      if (this.sync) {
        try {
          const written = Buffer.isBuffer(this._writingBuf) ? fs.writeSync(this.fd, this._writingBuf) : fs.writeSync(this.fd, this._writingBuf, "utf8");
          release(null, written);
        } catch (err) {
          release(err);
        }
      } else {
        fs.write(this.fd, this._writingBuf, release);
      }
    }
    function actualWriteBuffer() {
      const release = this.release;
      this._writing = true;
      this._writingBuf = this._writingBuf.length ? this._writingBuf : mergeBuf(this._bufs.shift(), this._lens.shift());
      if (this.sync) {
        try {
          const written = fs.writeSync(this.fd, this._writingBuf);
          release(null, written);
        } catch (err) {
          release(err);
        }
      } else {
        if (kCopyBuffer) {
          this._writingBuf = Buffer.from(this._writingBuf);
        }
        fs.write(this.fd, this._writingBuf, release);
      }
    }
    function actualClose(sonic) {
      if (sonic.fd === -1) {
        sonic.once("ready", actualClose.bind(null, sonic));
        return;
      }
      if (sonic._periodicFlushTimer !== void 0) {
        clearInterval(sonic._periodicFlushTimer);
      }
      sonic.destroyed = true;
      sonic._bufs = [];
      sonic._lens = [];
      assert(typeof sonic.fd === "number", `sonic.fd must be a number, got ${typeof sonic.fd}`);
      try {
        fs.fsync(sonic.fd, closeWrapped);
      } catch {
      }
      function closeWrapped() {
        if (sonic.fd !== 1 && sonic.fd !== 2) {
          fs.close(sonic.fd, done);
        } else {
          done();
        }
      }
      function done(err) {
        if (err) {
          sonic.emit("error", err);
          return;
        }
        if (sonic._ending && !sonic._writing) {
          sonic.emit("finish");
        }
        sonic.emit("close");
      }
    }
    SonicBoom.SonicBoom = SonicBoom;
    SonicBoom.default = SonicBoom;
    module.exports = SonicBoom;
  }

      }
    }

        return;
      }

        }

      refs[event] = [];
    }

        const index = refs[event].indexOf(ref);
        refs[event].splice(index, index + 1);

      }

      registry.register(obj, ref);
      refs[event].push(ref);
    }

    }
    function registerBeforeExit(obj, fn) {
      _register("beforeExit", obj, fn);
    }

      if (registry === void 0) {
        return;
      }
      registry.unregister(obj);

var require_wait = __commonJS({
  "../../node_modules/.pnpm/thread-stream@3.1.0/node_modules/thread-stream/lib/wait.js"(exports, module) {
    "use strict";
    var MAX_TIMEOUT = 1e3;
    function wait(state, index, expected, timeout, done) {
      const max = Date.now() + timeout;
      let current = Atomics.load(state, index);
      if (current === expected) {
        done(null, "ok");
        return;
      }
      let prior = current;
      const check = (backoff) => {
        if (Date.now() > max) {
          done(null, "timed-out");
        } else {
          setTimeout(() => {
            prior = current;
            current = Atomics.load(state, index);
            if (current === prior) {
              check(backoff >= MAX_TIMEOUT ? MAX_TIMEOUT : backoff * 2);
            } else {
              if (current === expected) done(null, "ok");
              else done(null, "not-equal");
            }
          }, backoff);
        }
      };
      check(1);
    }
    function waitDiff(state, index, expected, timeout, done) {
      const max = Date.now() + timeout;
      let current = Atomics.load(state, index);
      if (current !== expected) {
        done(null, "ok");
        return;
      }
      const check = (backoff) => {
        if (Date.now() > max) {
          done(null, "timed-out");
        } else {
          setTimeout(() => {
            current = Atomics.load(state, index);
            if (current !== expected) {
              done(null, "ok");
            } else {
              check(backoff >= MAX_TIMEOUT ? MAX_TIMEOUT : backoff * 2);
            }
          }, backoff);
        }
      };
      check(1);
    }
    module.exports = { wait, waitDiff };
  }
});

        stream.flushSync();
        let readIndex = Atomics.load(stream[kImpl].state, READ_INDEX);
        Atomics.store(stream[kImpl].state, WRITE_INDEX, -1);
        Atomics.notify(stream[kImpl].state, WRITE_INDEX);
        let spins = 0;
        while (readIndex !== -1) {
          Atomics.wait(stream[kImpl].state, READ_INDEX, readIndex, 1e3);
          readIndex = Atomics.load(stream[kImpl].state, READ_INDEX);
          if (readIndex === -2) {
            destroy(stream, new Error("end() failed"));
            return;
          }
          if (++spins === 10) {
            destroy(stream, new Error("end() took too long (10s)"));
            return;
          }
        }
        process.nextTick(() => {
          stream[kImpl].finished = true;
          stream.emit("finish");
        });
      } catch (err) {
        destroy(stream, err);
      }
    }
    function writeSync(stream) {
      const cb = () => {
        if (stream[kImpl].ending) {
          end(stream);
        } else if (stream[kImpl].needDrain) {
          process.nextTick(drain, stream);
        }
      };
      stream[kImpl].flushing = false;
      while (stream[kImpl].buf.length !== 0) {
        const writeIndex = Atomics.load(stream[kImpl].state, WRITE_INDEX);
        let leftover = stream[kImpl].data.length - writeIndex;
        if (leftover === 0) {
          flushSync(stream);
          Atomics.store(stream[kImpl].state, READ_INDEX, 0);
          Atomics.store(stream[kImpl].state, WRITE_INDEX, 0);
          continue;
        } else if (leftover < 0) {
          throw new Error("overwritten");
        }
        let toWrite = stream[kImpl].buf.slice(0, leftover);
        let toWriteBytes = Buffer.byteLength(toWrite);
        if (toWriteBytes <= leftover) {
          stream[kImpl].buf = stream[kImpl].buf.slice(leftover);
          write(stream, toWrite, cb);
        } else {
          flushSync(stream);
          Atomics.store(stream[kImpl].state, READ_INDEX, 0);
          Atomics.store(stream[kImpl].state, WRITE_INDEX, 0);
          while (toWriteBytes > stream[kImpl].buf.length) {
            leftover = leftover / 2;
            toWrite = stream[kImpl].buf.slice(0, leftover);
            toWriteBytes = Buffer.byteLength(toWrite);
          }
          stream[kImpl].buf = stream[kImpl].buf.slice(leftover);
          write(stream, toWrite, cb);
        }
      }
    }
    function flushSync(stream) {
      if (stream[kImpl].flushing) {
        throw new Error("unable to flush while flushing");
      }
      const writeIndex = Atomics.load(stream[kImpl].state, WRITE_INDEX);
      let spins = 0;
      while (true) {
        const readIndex = Atomics.load(stream[kImpl].state, READ_INDEX);
        if (readIndex === -2) {
          throw Error("_flushSync failed");
        }
        if (readIndex !== writeIndex) {
          Atomics.wait(stream[kImpl].state, READ_INDEX, readIndex, 1e3);
        } else {
          break;
        }
        if (++spins === 10) {
          throw new Error("_flushSync took too long (10s)");
        }
      }
    }
    module.exports = ThreadStream;
  }
});

      });

      const options = {

        options.pipelines = [pipeline.map((dest) => {
          return {
            ...dest,
            target: fixTarget(dest.target)
          };
        })];

        if (isAbsolute(origin) || origin.indexOf("file://") === 0) {
          return origin;
        }

          return join(__dirname, "..", "file.js");
        }

            fixTarget2 = createRequire(context).resolve(origin);
            break;
          } catch (err) {
            continue;
          }
        }

          throw new Error(`unable to determine transport target for "${origin}"`);
        }

      }
    }

                res += `${separator}${strEscape(key2)}:${tmp}`;
                separator = ",";
              }

              const removedKeys = keyLength - maximumBreadth;
              res += `${separator}"...":"${getItemCount(removedKeys)} not stringified"`;
            }
            stack.pop();

          }

          case "undefined":
            return void 0;
          case "bigint":

            }

            }
            if (Array.isArray(replacer)) {
              return stringifyArrayReplacer("", value, [], getUniqueReplacerSet(replacer), spacer, "");
            }
          }
          if (spacer.length !== 0) {
            return stringifyIndent("", value, [], spacer, "");
          }
        }
        return stringifySimple("", value, []);
      }
      return stringify2;

    function transform(chunk, enc, cb) {

    module.exports = async function({ targets, pipelines, levels, dedupe }) {
      const targetStreams = [];
      if (targets && targets.length) {
        targets = await Promise.all(targets.map(async (t) => {
          const fn = await loadTransportStreamBuilder(t.target);
          const stream = await fn(t.options);
          return {
            level: t.level,
            stream
          };
        }));
        targetStreams.push(...targets);
      }
      if (pipelines && pipelines.length) {
        pipelines = await Promise.all(
          pipelines.map(async (p) => {
            let level;
            const pipeDests = await Promise.all(
              p.map(
                async (t) => {
                  level = t.level;
                  const fn = await loadTransportStreamBuilder(t.target);
                  const stream = await fn(t.options);
                  return stream;
                }
              )
            );
            return {
              level,
              stream: createPipeline(pipeDests)
            };
          })
        );
        targetStreams.push(...pipelines);
      }
      if (targetStreams.length === 1) {
        return targetStreams[0].stream;
      } else {
        return build(process2, {
          parse: "lines",
          metadata: true,
          close(err, cb) {
            let expected = 0;
            for (const transport of targetStreams) {
              expected++;
              transport.stream.on("close", closeCb);
              transport.stream.end();
            }
            function closeCb() {
              if (--expected === 0) {
                cb(err);
              }
            }
          }
        });
      }
      function process2(stream) {
        const multi = pino.multistream(targetStreams, { levels, dedupe });
        stream.on("data", function(chunk) {
          const { lastTime, lastMsg, lastObj, lastLevel } = this;
          multi.lastLevel = lastLevel;
          multi.lastTime = lastTime;
          multi.lastMsg = lastMsg;
          multi.lastObj = lastObj;
          multi.write(chunk + "\n");
        });
      }
      function createPipeline(streams) {
        const ee = new EE();
        const stream = new PassThrough({
          autoDestroy: true,
          destroy(_, cb) {
            ee.on("error", cb);
            ee.on("closed", cb);
          }
        });
        pipeline(stream, ...streams, function(err) {
          if (err && err.code !== "ERR_STREAM_PREMATURE_CLOSE") {
            ee.emit("error", err);
            return;
          }
          ee.emit("closed");
        });
        return stream;
      }
    };
  }
});
export default require_worker();

function run() {
  const current = Atomics.load(state, READ_INDEX);
  const end = Atomics.load(state, WRITE_INDEX);
  if (end === current) {
    if (end === data.length) {
      waitDiff(state, READ_INDEX, end, Infinity, run);
    } else {
      waitDiff(state, WRITE_INDEX, end, Infinity, run);
    }
    return;
  }
  if (end === -1) {
    destination.end();
    return;
  }
  const toWrite = data.toString("utf8", current, end);
  const res = destination.write(toWrite);
  if (res) {
    Atomics.store(state, READ_INDEX, end);
    Atomics.notify(state, READ_INDEX);
    setImmediate(run);
  } else {
    destination.once("drain", function() {
      Atomics.store(state, READ_INDEX, end);
      Atomics.notify(state, READ_INDEX);
      run();
    });
  }

import express, { type Express } from "express";
import cors from "cors";
import pinoHttp from "pino-http";
import { clerkMiddleware } from "@clerk/express";
import { publishableKeyFromHost } from "@clerk/shared/keys";
import router from "./routes";
import { logger } from "./lib/logger";
import {
  CLERK_PROXY_PATH,
  clerkProxyMiddleware,
  getClerkProxyHost,
} from "./middlewares/clerkProxyMiddleware";
import { InventoryError } from "./lib/inventory-error";

const app: Express = express();

app.use(
  pinoHttp({
    logger,
    serializers: {
      req(req) {
        return {
          id: req.id,
          method: req.method,
          url: req.url?.split("?")[0],
        };
      },
      res(res) {
        return {
          statusCode: res.statusCode,
        };
      },
    },
  }),
);
app.use(CLERK_PROXY_PATH, clerkProxyMiddleware());
app.use(cors({ credentials: true, origin: true }));
app.use(express.json());
app.use(express.urlencoded({ extended: true }));
app.use(
  clerkMiddleware((req) => ({
    publishableKey: publishableKeyFromHost(
      getClerkProxyHost(req) ?? "",
      process.env.CLERK_PUBLISHABLE_KEY,
    ),
  })),
);

app.use("/api", router);

app.use((error: unknown, req: express.Request, res: express.Response, _next: express.NextFunction) => {
  if (error instanceof InventoryError) {
    res.status(error.status).json({ error: error.message });
    return;
  }
  const code = typeof error === "object" && error !== null
    ? ("code" in error ? error.code : "cause" in error && typeof error.cause === "object" && error.cause !== null && "code" in error.cause ? error.cause.code : undefined)
    : undefined;
  if (code === "23505" || code === "23503") {
    res.status(409).json({ error: "This record conflicts with an existing inventory record." });
    return;
  }
  req.log.error({ err: error }, "Inventory API error");
  res.status(500).json({ error: "Something went wrong. Please try again." });
});

export default app;

import app from "./app";
import { logger } from "./lib/logger";

const rawPort = process.env["PORT"];

if (!rawPort) {
  throw new Error(
    "PORT environment variable is required but was not provided.",
  );
}

const port = Number(rawPort);

if (Number.isNaN(port) || port <= 0) {
  throw new Error(`Invalid PORT value: "${rawPort}"`);
}

app.listen(port, (err) => {
  if (err) {
    logger.error({ err }, "Error listening on port");
    process.exit(1);
  }

  logger.info({ port }, "Server listening");
});

import { InventoryError } from "./inventory-error";

export type Pin = { latitude: number; longitude: number };
export type GooglePlace = Pin & { placeId: string; address: string };

const requests = new Map<string, number[]>();
const LIMIT = 30;
const WINDOW_MS = 60_000;

export function googlePlacesEnabled() {
  return Boolean(process.env.GOOGLE_MAPS_SERVER_KEY && process.env.GOOGLE_MAPS_BROWSER_KEY);
}

export function limitGoogleRequests(ownerId: string) {
  const now = Date.now();
  if (requests.size > 500) {
    for (const [id, entries] of requests) {
      if (entries.at(-1)! < now - WINDOW_MS) requests.delete(id);
    }
  }
  const entries = (requests.get(ownerId) ?? []).filter(time => time > now - WINDOW_MS);
  if (entries.length >= LIMIT) throw new InventoryError("Google place limit reached (30 lookups per minute). Try again in a minute.", 429);
  entries.push(now);
  requests.set(ownerId, entries);
}

async function googleRequest<T>(url: string, options?: { body: unknown; fieldMask?: string }): Promise<T> {
  if (!googlePlacesEnabled()) throw new InventoryError("Google place picking is not configured. You can still enter an address manually.", 503);
  const controller = new AbortController();
  const timeout = setTimeout(() => controller.abort(), 8000);
  try {
    const response = await fetch(url, {
      method: options ? "POST" : "GET",
      headers: {
        "X-Goog-Api-Key": process.env.GOOGLE_MAPS_SERVER_KEY!,
        ...(options?.fieldMask ? { "X-Goog-FieldMask": options.fieldMask } : {}),
        ...(options ? { "Content-Type": "application/json" } : {}),
      },
      ...(options ? { body: JSON.stringify(options.body) } : {}),
      signal: controller.signal,
    });
    if (response.status === 429) throw new InventoryError("Google Maps has reached its usage limit. Try again later or enter an address manually.", 429);
    if (response.status === 403 || response.status === 401) throw new InventoryError("Google Maps access was denied. Check that Places API (New) and Geocoding API are enabled and billing and key restrictions are correct.", 503);
    if (response.status === 404) throw new InventoryError("Google place no longer exists. Search again.", 422);
    if (!response.ok) throw new InventoryError("Google Maps could not complete this lookup. Try again or enter an address manually.", 502);
    return await response.json() as T;
  } catch (error) {
    if (error instanceof InventoryError) throw error;
    throw new InventoryError("Google Maps did not respond. Try again or enter an address manually.", 502);
  } finally {
    clearTimeout(timeout);
  }
}

export async function suggestGooglePlaces(input: string) {
  const result = await googleRequest<{
    suggestions?: { placePrediction?: { placeId?: string; text?: { text?: string } } }[];
  }>("https://places.googleapis.com/v1/places:autocomplete", {
    body: { input },
    fieldMask: "suggestions.placePrediction.placeId,suggestions.placePrediction.text.text",
  });
  return (result.suggestions ?? []).flatMap(({ placePrediction }) =>
    placePrediction?.placeId && placePrediction.text?.text
      ? [{ placeId: placePrediction.placeId, text: placePrediction.text.text }]
      : []);
}

export async function resolveGooglePlace(placeId: string): Promise<GooglePlace> {
  // Google IDs must not be allowed to alter the URL path.
  const result = await googleRequest<{ id?: string; formattedAddress?: string; location?: { latitude?: number; longitude?: number } }>(
    `https://places.googleapis.com/v1/places/${encodeURIComponent(placeId)}?fields=id,formattedAddress,location`,
  );
  if (!result.id || !result.formattedAddress || !Number.isFinite(result.location?.latitude) || !Number.isFinite(result.location?.longitude)) {
    throw new InventoryError("This Google place has no usable address or pin. Choose another place.", 422);
  }
  return { placeId: result.id, address: result.formattedAddress, latitude: result.location!.latitude!, longitude: result.location!.longitude! };
}

export async function resolveGooglePin(pin: Pin): Promise<GooglePlace> {
  const result = await googleRequest<{ results?: { place_id?: string; formatted_address?: string }[]; status?: string }>(
    `https://maps.googleapis.com/maps/api/geocode/json?latlng=${pin.latitude},${pin.longitude}&key=${encodeURIComponent(process.env.GOOGLE_MAPS_SERVER_KEY!)}`,
  );
  if (result.status === "OVER_QUERY_LIMIT") throw new InventoryError("Google Maps has reached its usage limit. Try again later.", 429);
  if (result.status === "REQUEST_DENIED") throw new InventoryError("Google Geocoding access was denied. Check API access, billing and key restrictions.", 503);
  const first = result.results?.[0];
  if (!first?.place_id || !first.formatted_address) throw new InventoryError("No Google address was found at this pin. Choose another point.", 422);
  return { placeId: first.place_id, address: first.formatted_address, ...pin };
}

export class InventoryError extends Error {
  constructor(
    message: string,
    public readonly status = 400,
  ) {
    super(message);
    this.name = "InventoryError";
  }
}

import { eq } from "drizzle-orm";
import { currencyDigits } from "./pricing";
import {
  db,
  categories,
  products,
  warehouses,
  locations,
  balances,
  operations,
  operationLines,
  stockMoves,
} from "@workspace/db";

export async function enrichedProducts(ownerId: string, warehouseId?: number) {
  const [productRows, categoryRows, balanceRows, locationRows, warehouseRows] = await Promise.all([
    db.select().from(products).where(eq(products.ownerId, ownerId)),
    db.select().from(categories).where(eq(categories.ownerId, ownerId)),
    db.select().from(balances).where(eq(balances.ownerId, ownerId)),
    db.select().from(locations).where(eq(locations.ownerId, ownerId)),
    db.select().from(warehouses).where(eq(warehouses.ownerId, ownerId)),
  ]);
  const categoryById = new Map(categoryRows.map((category) => [category.id, category]));
  const locationById = new Map(locationRows.map((location) => [location.id, location]));
  const warehouseById = new Map(warehouseRows.map((warehouse) => [warehouse.id, warehouse]));

  return productRows
    .filter((product) => product.active)
    .map((product) => {
      const locationStocks = balanceRows
        .filter((balance) => balance.productId === product.id)
        .flatMap((balance) => {
          const location = locationById.get(balance.locationId);
          if (!location || (warehouseId && location.warehouseId !== warehouseId)) return [];
          const warehouse = warehouseById.get(location.warehouseId);
          if (!warehouse) return [];
          return [{
            locationId: location.id,
            locationName: location.name,
            warehouseId: warehouse.id,
            warehouseName: warehouse.name,
            quantity: balance.quantity,
          }];
        });
      const totalStock = locationStocks.reduce((sum, stock) => sum + stock.quantity, 0);
      const stockStatus = totalStock <= 0
        ? "out" as const
        : totalStock <= product.reorderPoint
          ? "low" as const
          : "healthy" as const;
      const defaultLocation = product.defaultLocationId
        ? locationById.get(product.defaultLocationId)
        : undefined;
      return {
        id: product.id,
        name: product.name,
        sku: product.sku,
        categoryId: product.categoryId,
        categoryName: product.categoryId ? categoryById.get(product.categoryId)?.name ?? null : null,
        defaultLocationId: product.defaultLocationId,
        defaultLocationName: product.defaultLocationId
          ? defaultLocation?.name ?? null
          : null,
        defaultWarehouseName: product.defaultLocationId
          ? defaultLocation ? warehouseById.get(defaultLocation.warehouseId)?.name ?? null : null
          : null,
        unit: product.unit,
        reorderPoint: product.reorderPoint,
        sellingPriceUsd: product.sellingPriceCurrency !== "USD" ? null
          : product.sellingPriceMinor !== null ? product.sellingPriceMinor / 100
          : product.sellingPriceCents === null ? null : product.sellingPriceCents / 100,
        sellingPrice: product.sellingPriceMinor !== null
          ? product.sellingPriceMinor / (10 ** currencyDigits(product.sellingPriceCurrency))
          : product.sellingPriceCents === null ? null : product.sellingPriceCents / 100,
        currencyCode: product.sellingPriceCurrency,
        totalStock,
        stockStatus,
        locationStocks,
        createdAt: product.createdAt.toISOString(),
      };
    })
    .sort((a, b) => a.name.localeCompare(b.name));
}

export async function enrichedOperations(ownerId: string) {
  const [operationRows, lineRows, productRows, locationRows] = await Promise.all([
    db.select().from(operations).where(eq(operations.ownerId, ownerId)),
    db.select().from(operationLines).where(eq(operationLines.ownerId, ownerId)),
    db.select().from(products).where(eq(products.ownerId, ownerId)),
    db.select().from(locations).where(eq(locations.ownerId, ownerId)),
  ]);
  const productById = new Map(productRows.map((product) => [product.id, product]));
  const locationById = new Map(locationRows.map((location) => [location.id, location]));

  return operationRows
    .map((operation) => ({
      id: operation.id,
      reference: operation.reference,
      type: operation.type as "receipt" | "delivery" | "transfer" | "adjustment",
      status: operation.status as "draft" | "waiting" | "ready" | "done" | "canceled",
      contact: operation.contact,
      sourceLocationId: operation.sourceLocationId,
      sourceLocationName: operation.sourceLocationId
        ? locationById.get(operation.sourceLocationId)?.name ?? null
        : null,
      destinationLocationId: operation.destinationLocationId,
      destinationLocationName: operation.destinationLocationId
        ? locationById.get(operation.destinationLocationId)?.name ?? null
        : null,
      scheduledAt: operation.scheduledAt?.toISOString() ?? null,
      courierEmail: operation.courierEmail,
      deliveryStartedAt: operation.deliveryStartedAt?.toISOString() ?? null,
      deliveryCompletedAt: operation.deliveryCompletedAt?.toISOString() ?? null,
      createdAt: operation.createdAt.toISOString(),
      lines: lineRows
        .filter((line) => line.operationId === operation.id)
        .map((line) => {
          const product = productById.get(line.productId);
          return {
            id: line.id,
            productId: line.productId,
            productName: product?.name ?? "Archived product",
            sku: product?.sku ?? "",
            unit: product?.unit ?? "units",
            quantity: line.quantity,
            countedQuantity: line.countedQuantity,
          };
        }),
    }))
    .sort((a, b) => b.id - a.id);
}

export async function enrichedMoves(ownerId: string) {
  const [moveRows, productRows, locationRows] = await Promise.all([
    db.select().from(stockMoves).where(eq(stockMoves.ownerId, ownerId)),
    db.select().from(products).where(eq(products.ownerId, ownerId)),
    db.select().from(locations).where(eq(locations.ownerId, ownerId)),
  ]);
  const productById = new Map(productRows.map((product) => [product.id, product]));
  const locationById = new Map(locationRows.map((location) => [location.id, location]));
  return moveRows
    .map((move) => ({
      id: move.id,
      productId: move.productId,
      productName: productById.get(move.productId)?.name ?? "Archived product",
      sku: productById.get(move.productId)?.sku ?? "",
      type: move.type as "receipt" | "delivery" | "transfer" | "adjustment",
      operationId: move.operationId,
      reference: move.reference,
      sourceLocationName: move.sourceLocationId
        ? locationById.get(move.sourceLocationId)?.name ?? null
        : null,
      destinationLocationName: move.destinationLocationId
        ? locationById.get(move.destinationLocationId)?.name ?? null
        : null,
      sourceLocationId: move.sourceLocationId,
      destinationLocationId: move.destinationLocationId,
      quantity: move.quantity,
      movedAt: move.movedAt.toISOString(),
    }))
    .sort((a, b) => b.id - a.id);
}

import { InventoryError } from "./inventory-error";

const supportedCurrencies = new Set(Intl.supportedValuesOf("currency"));

export function currencyDigits(currency: string): number {
  if (!supportedCurrencies.has(currency)) {
    throw new InventoryError("Choose a supported currency code.", 400);
  }
  return new Intl.NumberFormat("en", { style: "currency", currency })
    .resolvedOptions().maximumFractionDigits ?? 2;
}

export function priceFields(
  sellingPrice: number | null | undefined,
  sellingPriceUsd: number | null | undefined,
  currencyCode: string | undefined,
  existingCurrency = "USD",
) {
  if (sellingPrice !== undefined && sellingPriceUsd !== undefined) {
    throw new InventoryError("Use either sellingPrice or sellingPriceUsd, not both.", 400);
  }
  if (sellingPriceUsd !== undefined && currencyCode && currencyCode !== "USD") {
    throw new InventoryError("A USD price cannot be saved with a different currency.", 400);
  }
  const currency = sellingPriceUsd !== undefined ? "USD" : currencyCode ?? existingCurrency;
  const digits = currencyDigits(currency);
  const amount = sellingPriceUsd !== undefined ? sellingPriceUsd : sellingPrice;
  if (amount === undefined) {
    if (currency !== existingCurrency) {
      throw new InventoryError("Enter a new price or clear it when changing currencies.", 400);
    }
    return { sellingPriceCurrency: currency };
  }
  if (amount === null) {
    return { sellingPriceCurrency: currency, sellingPriceMinor: null, sellingPriceCents: null };
  }
  const factor = 10 ** digits;
  const minor = Math.round(amount * factor);
  if (!Number.isFinite(amount) || amount < 0 || amount > 1_000_000 ||
      minor > 2_147_483_647 || minor / factor !== amount) {
    throw new InventoryError(`Enter a ${currency} price from 0 to 1,000,000 with no more than ${digits} decimal places.`, 400);
  }
  return {
    sellingPriceCurrency: currency,
    // This new field always stores the currency's own smallest unit, not cents.
    sellingPriceMinor: minor,
    // Keep the old USD column in sync for existing integrations.
    sellingPriceCents: currency === "USD" ? minor : null,
  };
}

FILE: artifacts/api-server/src/middlewares/clerkProxyMiddleware.ts
==========================================================================================
import type { IncomingHttpHeaders } from "http";
import type { RequestHandler } from "express";
import { createProxyMiddleware } from "http-proxy-middleware";

const CLERK_FAPI = "https://frontend-api.clerk.dev";
export const CLERK_PROXY_PATH = "/api/__clerk";

export function getClerkProxyHost(req: {
  headers: IncomingHttpHeaders;
}): string | undefined {
  const forwarded = req.headers["x-forwarded-host"];
  const raw = Array.isArray(forwarded) ? forwarded[0] : forwarded;
  const firstHop = raw?.split(",")[0]?.trim();
  return firstHop || req.headers.host?.trim() || undefined;
}

export function clerkProxyMiddleware(): RequestHandler {
  if (process.env.NODE_ENV !== "production") {
    return (_req, _res, next) => next();
  }

  const secretKey = process.env.CLERK_SECRET_KEY;
  if (!secretKey) {
    return (_req, _res, next) => next();
  }

  return createProxyMiddleware({
    target: CLERK_FAPI,
    changeOrigin: true,
    selfHandleResponse: true,
    pathRewrite: (path: string) =>
      path.replace(new RegExp(`^${CLERK_PROXY_PATH}`), ""),
    on: {
      proxyReq: (proxyReq, req) => {
        const protocol = req.headers["x-forwarded-proto"] || "https";
        const host = getClerkProxyHost(req) || "";
        const proxyUrl = `${protocol}://${host}${CLERK_PROXY_PATH}`;

        proxyReq.setHeader("Clerk-Proxy-Url", proxyUrl);
        proxyReq.setHeader("Clerk-Secret-Key", secretKey);

        const xff = req.headers["x-forwarded-for"];
        const clientIp =
          (Array.isArray(xff) ? xff[0] : xff)?.split(",")[0]?.trim() ||
          req.socket?.remoteAddress ||
          "";
        if (clientIp) {
          proxyReq.setHeader("X-Forwarded-For", clientIp);
        }
      },
      proxyRes: (proxyRes, req, res) => {
        const headers = { ...proxyRes.headers };
        delete headers["transfer-encoding"];
        delete headers["connection"];
        delete headers["keep-alive"];

        const status = proxyRes.statusCode ?? 502;
        if (status < 200 || status === 204) {
          delete headers["content-length"];
        }

        const bodyless =
          req.method === "HEAD" ||
          status < 200 ||
          status === 204 ||
          status === 304;
        if (headers["content-length"] !== undefined || bodyless) {
          res.writeHead(status, headers);
          proxyRes.on("error", () => res.destroy());
          proxyRes.pipe(res);
          return;
        }

        const chunks: Buffer[] = [];
        proxyRes.on("data", (chunk: Buffer) => chunks.push(chunk));
        proxyRes.on("end", () => {
          const body = Buffer.concat(chunks);
          headers["content-length"] = String(body.length);
          res.writeHead(status, headers);
          res.end(body);
        });
        proxyRes.on("error", () => {
          if (!res.headersSent) {
            res.writeHead(502, { "content-length": "0" });
          }
          res.end();
        });
      },
    },
  }) as RequestHandler;
}

FILE: artifacts/api-server/src/middlewares/inventory-auth.ts

import { getAuth } from "@clerk/express";
import type { RequestHandler } from "express";
import { db, operations } from "@workspace/db";
import { eq } from "drizzle-orm";
import { ensureInventoryWorkspace } from "../lib/inventory-workspace";

export const requireInventoryAuth: RequestHandler = async (req, res, next) => {
  const userId = getAuth(req).userId;
  if (!userId) {
    res.status(401).json({ error: "Please sign in to access your inventory." });
    return;
  }

  res.locals.ownerId = userId;
  try {
    const [assignment] = await db.select({ id: operations.id }).from(operations)
      .where(eq(operations.courierUserId, userId)).limit(1);
    if (assignment) {
      if (/^\/operations\/\d+\/delivery\/(start|complete)$/.test(req.path) && req.method === "POST") {
        next();
        return;
      }
      res.status(403).json({ error: "Courier accounts can access only their assigned deliveries." });
      return;
    }
    await ensureInventoryWorkspace(userId);
    next();
  } catch (error) {
    next(error);
  }
};

import { and, eq } from "drizzle-orm";
import { Router, type IRouter } from "express";
import {
  db,
  balances,
  categories,
  locations,
  products,
  stockMoves,
} from "@workspace/db";
import {
  ListProductsQueryParams,
  ListProductsResponse,
  CreateProductBody,
  CreateProductResponse,
  GetProductParams,
  GetProductResponse,
  UpdateProductParams,
  UpdateProductBody,
  UpdateProductResponse,
  DeleteProductParams,
  ListCategoriesResponse,
  CreateCategoryBody,
  CreateCategoryResponse,
  UpdateCategoryParams,
  UpdateCategoryBody,
  UpdateCategoryResponse,
  DeleteCategoryParams,
} from "@workspace/api-zod";
import { enrichedProducts } from "../lib/inventory-queries";
import { InventoryError } from "../lib/inventory-error";
import { priceFields } from "../lib/pricing";

const router: IRouter = Router();

async function requireCategory(ownerId: string, categoryId: number | null | undefined) {
  if (categoryId == null) return;
  const [category] = await db
    .select({ id: categories.id })
    .from(categories)
    .where(and(eq(categories.id, categoryId), eq(categories.ownerId, ownerId)))
    .limit(1);
  if (!category) throw new InventoryError("Choose a category in your inventory.", 400);
}

async function requireLocation(ownerId: string, locationId: number | null | undefined) {
  if (locationId == null) return;
  const [location] = await db.select({ id: locations.id }).from(locations)
    .where(and(eq(locations.id, locationId), eq(locations.ownerId, ownerId))).limit(1);
  if (!location) throw new InventoryError("Choose a location in your inventory.", 400);
}

router.get("/products", async (req, res): Promise<void> => {
  const parsed = ListProductsQueryParams.safeParse(req.query);
  if (!parsed.success) {
    res.status(400).json({ error: parsed.error.message });
    return;
  }
  const { search, categoryId, warehouseId, stockStatus } = parsed.data;
  const all = await enrichedProducts(res.locals.ownerId, warehouseId);
  const term = search?.trim().toLowerCase();
  const filtered = all.filter((product) =>
    (!term || product.name.toLowerCase().includes(term) || product.sku.toLowerCase().includes(term)) &&
    (categoryId == null || product.categoryId === categoryId) &&
    (!stockStatus || stockStatus === "all" || product.stockStatus === stockStatus),
  );
  res.json(ListProductsResponse.parse(filtered));
});

router.post("/products", async (req, res): Promise<void> => {
  const parsed = CreateProductBody.safeParse(req.body);
  if (!parsed.success) {
    res.status(400).json({ error: parsed.error.message });
    return;
  }
  const ownerId = res.locals.ownerId as string;
  const { name, sku, categoryId, unit, reorderPoint, sellingPrice, sellingPriceUsd, currencyCode, initialStock, initialLocationId, defaultLocationId } = parsed.data;
  const price = priceFields(sellingPrice, sellingPriceUsd, currencyCode, currencyCode ?? "USD");
  if (/^[\d.,\s]+$/.test(unit.trim())) throw new InventoryError("Unit must be a name such as pieces or boxes, not a stock quantity.", 400);
  if (initialStock !== undefined && (!Number.isFinite(initialStock) || initialStock < 0 ||
    initialStock > 100_000_000 || Math.round(initialStock * 1_000_000) / 1_000_000 !== initialStock)) {
    throw new InventoryError("Opening stock must be from 0 to 100,000,000 with at most six decimal places.", 400);
  }
  await requireCategory(ownerId, categoryId);
  await requireLocation(ownerId, defaultLocationId);
  const openingStockLocationId = initialLocationId ?? defaultLocationId;
  if ((initialStock ?? 0) > 0) {
    if (!openingStockLocationId) {
      throw new InventoryError("Choose a location for the initial stock.");
    }
    await requireLocation(ownerId, openingStockLocationId);
  }

  const createdId = await db.transaction(async (tx) => {
    const [product] = await tx.insert(products).values({
      ownerId,
      name: name.trim(),
      sku: sku.trim(),
      categoryId: categoryId ?? null,
      defaultLocationId: defaultLocationId ?? null,
      unit: unit.trim(),
      reorderPoint: reorderPoint ?? 0,
      ...price,
    }).returning();
    if ((initialStock ?? 0) > 0 && openingStockLocationId) {
      await tx.insert(balances).values({
        ownerId,
        productId: product.id,
        locationId: openingStockLocationId,
        quantity: initialStock!,
      });
      await tx.insert(stockMoves).values({
        ownerId,
        operationId: null,
        productId: product.id,
        type: "adjustment",
        reference: `OPEN-${product.id.toString().padStart(4, "0")}`,
        destinationLocationId: openingStockLocationId,
        quantity: initialStock!,
      });
    }
    return product.id;
  });
  const product = (await enrichedProducts(ownerId)).find((item) => item.id === createdId);
  res.status(201).json(CreateProductResponse.parse(product));
});

router.get("/products/:id", async (req, res): Promise<void> => {
  const params = GetProductParams.safeParse(req.params);
  if (!params.success) {
    res.status(400).json({ error: params.error.message });
    return;
  }
  const product = (await enrichedProducts(res.locals.ownerId)).find((item) => item.id === params.data.id);
  if (!product) {
    res.status(404).json({ error: "Product not found." });
    return;
  }
  res.json(GetProductResponse.parse(product));
});

router.patch("/products/:id", async (req, res): Promise<void> => {
  const params = UpdateProductParams.safeParse(req.params);
  const parsed = UpdateProductBody.safeParse(req.body);
  if (!params.success || !parsed.success) {
    res.status(400).json({ error: !params.success ? params.error.message : !parsed.success ? parsed.error.message : "Invalid request." });
    return;
  }
  const ownerId = res.locals.ownerId as string;
  await requireCategory(ownerId, parsed.data.categoryId);
  await requireLocation(ownerId, parsed.data.defaultLocationId);
  const { sellingPriceUsd, sellingPrice, currencyCode, ...updates } = parsed.data;
  if (parsed.data.unit !== undefined && /^[\d.,\s]+$/.test(parsed.data.unit.trim())) {
    throw new InventoryError("Unit must be a name such as pieces or boxes, not a stock quantity.", 400);
  }
  const [existing] = await db.select({ currency: products.sellingPriceCurrency }).from(products)
    .where(and(eq(products.id, params.data.id), eq(products.ownerId, ownerId), eq(products.active, true))).limit(1);
  if (!existing) {
    res.status(404).json({ error: "Product not found." });
    return;
  }
  const price = priceFields(sellingPrice, sellingPriceUsd, currencyCode, existing.currency);
  const [updated] = await db.update(products).set({
    ...updates,
    ...price,
    ...(parsed.data.name !== undefined ? { name: parsed.data.name.trim() } : {}),
    ...(parsed.data.sku !== undefined ? { sku: parsed.data.sku.trim() } : {}),
    ...(parsed.data.unit !== undefined ? { unit: parsed.data.unit.trim() } : {}),
  }).where(and(eq(products.id, params.data.id), eq(products.ownerId, ownerId), eq(products.active, true)))
    .returning({ id: products.id });
  if (!updated) {
    res.status(404).json({ error: "Product not found." });
    return;
  }
  const product = (await enrichedProducts(ownerId)).find((item) => item.id === updated.id);
  res.json(UpdateProductResponse.parse(product));
});

router.delete("/products/:id", async (req, res): Promise<void> => {
  const params = DeleteProductParams.safeParse(req.params);
  if (!params.success) {
    res.status(400).json({ error: params.error.message });
    return;
  }
  const ownerId = res.locals.ownerId as string;
  const [product] = await db.select({ id: products.id }).from(products)
    .where(and(eq(products.ownerId, ownerId), eq(products.id, params.data.id), eq(products.active, true))).limit(1);
  if (!product) {
    res.status(404).json({ error: "Product not found." });
    return;
  }
  const productBalances = await db.select({ quantity: balances.quantity }).from(balances)
    .where(and(eq(balances.ownerId, ownerId), eq(balances.productId, product.id)));
  if (productBalances.some((balance) => balance.quantity > 0)) {
    res.status(409).json({ error: "Remove or transfer this product's stock before archiving it." });
    return;
  }
  await db.update(products).set({ active: false })
    .where(and(eq(products.ownerId, ownerId), eq(products.id, product.id)));
  res.sendStatus(204);
});

router.get("/categories", async (_req, res): Promise<void> => {
  const ownerId = res.locals.ownerId as string;
  const [categoryRows, productRows] = await Promise.all([
    db.select().from(categories).where(eq(categories.ownerId, ownerId)),
    db.select({ categoryId: products.categoryId }).from(products)
      .where(and(eq(products.ownerId, ownerId), eq(products.active, true))),
  ]);
  res.json(ListCategoriesResponse.parse(categoryRows.map((category) => ({
    id: category.id,
    name: category.name,
    color: category.color,
    productCount: productRows.filter((product) => product.categoryId === category.id).length,
  }))));
});

router.post("/categories", async (req, res): Promise<void> => {
  const parsed = CreateCategoryBody.safeParse(req.body);
  if (!parsed.success) {
    res.status(400).json({ error: parsed.error.message });
    return;
  }
  const [category] = await db.insert(categories).values({
    ownerId: res.locals.ownerId,
    name: parsed.data.name.trim(),
    color: parsed.data.color ?? "#467B68",
  }).returning();
  res.status(201).json(CreateCategoryResponse.parse({ ...category, productCount: 0 }));
});

router.patch("/categories/:id", async (req, res): Promise<void> => {
  const params = UpdateCategoryParams.safeParse(req.params);
  const parsed = UpdateCategoryBody.safeParse(req.body);
  if (!params.success || !parsed.success) {
    res.status(400).json({ error: !params.success ? params.error.message : !parsed.success ? parsed.error.message : "Invalid request." });
    return;
  }
  const ownerId = res.locals.ownerId as string;
  const [category] = await db.update(categories).set({
    ...parsed.data,
    ...(parsed.data.name !== undefined ? { name: parsed.data.name.trim() } : {}),
  }).where(and(eq(categories.id, params.data.id), eq(categories.ownerId, ownerId))).returning();
  if (!category) {
    res.status(404).json({ error: "Category not found." });
    return;
  }
  const productRows = await db.select({ id: products.id }).from(products)
    .where(and(eq(products.ownerId, ownerId), eq(products.categoryId, category.id), eq(products.active, true)));
  res.json(UpdateCategoryResponse.parse({ ...category, productCount: productRows.length }));
});

router.delete("/categories/:id", async (req, res): Promise<void> => {
  const params = DeleteCategoryParams.safeParse(req.params);
  if (!params.success) {
    res.status(400).json({ error: params.error.message });
    return;
  }
  const ownerId = res.locals.ownerId as string;
  const productRows = await db.select({ id: products.id }).from(products)
    .where(and(eq(products.ownerId, ownerId), eq(products.categoryId, params.data.id))).limit(1);
  if (productRows.length) {
    res.status(409).json({ error: "Reassign products before deleting this category." });
    return;
  }
  const [deleted] = await db.delete(categories).where(and(eq(categories.id, params.data.id), eq(categories.ownerId, ownerId)))
    .returning({ id: categories.id });
  if (!deleted) {
    res.status(404).json({ error: "Category not found." });
    return;
  }
  res.sendStatus(204);
});

export default router;

import { and, eq } from "drizzle-orm";
import { getAuth } from "@clerk/express";
import { Router, type IRouter } from "express";
import { db, operations } from "@workspace/db";
import {
  GetCourierDeliveryParams,
  GetCourierDeliveryResponse,
  ListCourierDeliveriesResponse,
} from "@workspace/api-zod";

const router: IRouter = Router();

export function courierDelivery(row: typeof operations.$inferSelect) {
  return {
    id: row.id,
    reference: row.reference,
    contact: row.contact,
    scheduledAt: row.scheduledAt?.toISOString() ?? null,
    status: row.status,
    deliveryStartedAt: row.deliveryStartedAt?.toISOString() ?? null,
    deliveryCompletedAt: row.deliveryCompletedAt?.toISOString() ?? null,
  };
}

router.use((req, res, next) => {
  const userId = getAuth(req).userId;
  if (!userId) {
    res.status(401).json({ error: "Please sign in to view your deliveries." });
    return;
  }
  res.locals.courierId = userId;
  next();
});

router.get("/courier/deliveries", async (_req, res): Promise<void> => {
  const rows = await db.select().from(operations)
    .where(and(eq(operations.courierUserId, res.locals.courierId), eq(operations.type, "delivery")));
  res.json(ListCourierDeliveriesResponse.parse(rows.map(courierDelivery)));
});

router.get("/courier/deliveries/:id", async (req, res): Promise<void> => {
  const parsed = GetCourierDeliveryParams.safeParse(req.params);
  if (!parsed.success) {
    res.status(400).json({ error: parsed.error.message });
    return;
  }
  const [row] = await db.select().from(operations).where(and(
    eq(operations.id, parsed.data.id),
    eq(operations.type, "delivery"),
    eq(operations.courierUserId, res.locals.courierId),
  )).limit(1);
  if (!row) {
    res.status(404).json({ error: "Delivery not found." });
    return;
  }
  res.json(GetCourierDeliveryResponse.parse(courierDelivery(row)));
});

export default router;

import { and, eq, or } from "drizzle-orm";
import { Router, type IRouter } from "express";
import { db, balances, locations, operations, products, stockMoves, warehouses } from "@workspace/db";
import {
  ListWarehousesResponse,
  CreateWarehouseBody,
  CreateWarehouseResponse,
  UpdateWarehouseParams,
  UpdateWarehouseBody,
  UpdateWarehouseResponse,
  DeleteWarehouseParams,
  ListLocationsQueryParams,
  ListLocationsResponse,
  CreateLocationBody,
  CreateLocationResponse,
  UpdateLocationParams,
  UpdateLocationBody,
  UpdateLocationResponse,
  DeleteLocationParams,
  GetGooglePlacesConfigResponse,
  ListGooglePlaceSuggestionsQueryParams,
  ListGooglePlaceSuggestionsResponse,
  ResolveGooglePlaceBody,
  ResolveGooglePlaceResponse,
} from "@workspace/api-zod";
import { InventoryError } from "../lib/inventory-error";
import { googlePlacesEnabled, limitGoogleRequests, resolveGooglePin, resolveGooglePlace, suggestGooglePlaces } from "../lib/google-places";

const router: IRouter = Router();

async function warehouseById(ownerId: string, id: number) {
  const [warehouse] = await db.select().from(warehouses)
    .where(and(eq(warehouses.ownerId, ownerId), eq(warehouses.id, id))).limit(1);
  return warehouse;
}

async function locationById(ownerId: string, id: number) {
  const [location] = await db.select().from(locations)
    .where(and(eq(locations.ownerId, ownerId), eq(locations.id, id))).limit(1);
  return location;
}

async function requireValidParent(ownerId: string, parentId: number | null | undefined, warehouseId: number, selfId?: number) {
  if (parentId == null) return;
  if (parentId === selfId) throw new InventoryError("A location cannot be its own parent.");
  const parent = await locationById(ownerId, parentId);
  if (!parent || parent.warehouseId !== warehouseId) {
    throw new InventoryError("Choose a parent location in the same warehouse.");
  }
  // The location hierarchy is kept shallow so a parent cannot be a child of this location.
  if (selfId && parent.parentId === selfId) {
    throw new InventoryError("A location cannot be nested inside one of its children.");
  }
}

function validateCoordinatePair(latitude: number | null | undefined, longitude: number | null | undefined) {
  const hasLatitude = latitude !== undefined;
  const hasLongitude = longitude !== undefined;
  if (hasLatitude !== hasLongitude || (hasLatitude && (latitude === null) !== (longitude === null))) {
    throw new InventoryError("Latitude and longitude must be provided together or both be null.");
  }
}

router.get("/warehouses", async (_req, res): Promise<void> => {
  const ownerId = res.locals.ownerId as string;
  const [warehouseRows, locationRows] = await Promise.all([
    db.select().from(warehouses).where(eq(warehouses.ownerId, ownerId)),
    db.select().from(locations).where(eq(locations.ownerId, ownerId)),
  ]);
  res.json(ListWarehousesResponse.parse(warehouseRows.map((warehouse) => ({
    ...warehouse,
    locationCount: locationRows.filter((location) => location.warehouseId === warehouse.id).length,
  }))));
});

router.post("/warehouses", async (req, res): Promise<void> => {
  const parsed = CreateWarehouseBody.safeParse(req.body);
  if (!parsed.success) {
    res.status(400).json({ error: parsed.error.message });
    return;
  }
  const [warehouse] = await db.insert(warehouses).values({
    ownerId: res.locals.ownerId,
    name: parsed.data.name.trim(),
    code: parsed.data.code.trim().toUpperCase(),
    address: parsed.data.address ?? null,
  }).returning();
  res.status(201).json(CreateWarehouseResponse.parse({ ...warehouse, locationCount: 0 }));
});

router.patch("/warehouses/:id", async (req, res): Promise<void> => {
  const params = UpdateWarehouseParams.safeParse(req.params);
  const parsed = UpdateWarehouseBody.safeParse(req.body);
  if (!params.success || !parsed.success) {
    res.status(400).json({ error: !params.success ? params.error.message : !parsed.success ? parsed.error.message : "Invalid request." });
    return;
  }
  const ownerId = res.locals.ownerId as string;
  const [warehouse] = await db.update(warehouses).set({
    ...parsed.data,
    ...(parsed.data.name !== undefined ? { name: parsed.data.name.trim() } : {}),
    ...(parsed.data.code !== undefined ? { code: parsed.data.code.trim().toUpperCase() } : {}),
  }).where(and(eq(warehouses.ownerId, ownerId), eq(warehouses.id, params.data.id))).returning();
  if (!warehouse) {
    res.status(404).json({ error: "Warehouse not found." });
    return;
  }
  const locationRows = await db.select({ id: locations.id }).from(locations)
    .where(and(eq(locations.ownerId, ownerId), eq(locations.warehouseId, warehouse.id)));
  res.json(UpdateWarehouseResponse.parse({ ...warehouse, locationCount: locationRows.length }));
});

router.delete("/warehouses/:id", async (req, res): Promise<void> => {
  const params = DeleteWarehouseParams.safeParse(req.params);
  if (!params.success) {
    res.status(400).json({ error: params.error.message });
    return;
  }
  const ownerId = res.locals.ownerId as string;
  const locationRows = await db.select({ id: locations.id }).from(locations)
    .where(and(eq(locations.ownerId, ownerId), eq(locations.warehouseId, params.data.id))).limit(1);
  if (locationRows.length) {
    res.status(409).json({ error: "Remove this warehouse's locations first." });
    return;
  }
  const [deleted] = await db.delete(warehouses)
    .where(and(eq(warehouses.ownerId, ownerId), eq(warehouses.id, params.data.id)))
    .returning({ id: warehouses.id });
  if (!deleted) {
    res.status(404).json({ error: "Warehouse not found." });
    return;
  }
  res.sendStatus(204);
});

router.get("/locations", async (req, res): Promise<void> => {
  const parsed = ListLocationsQueryParams.safeParse(req.query);
  if (!parsed.success) {
    res.status(400).json({ error: parsed.error.message });
    return;
  }
  const ownerId = res.locals.ownerId as string;
  const [locationRows, warehouseRows] = await Promise.all([
    db.select().from(locations).where(eq(locations.ownerId, ownerId)),
    db.select().from(warehouses).where(eq(warehouses.ownerId, ownerId)),
  ]);
  const warehouseById = new Map(warehouseRows.map((warehouse) => [warehouse.id, warehouse]));
  res.json(ListLocationsResponse.parse(locationRows
    .filter((location) => !parsed.data.warehouseId || location.warehouseId === parsed.data.warehouseId)
    .map((location) => ({
      ...location,
      warehouseName: warehouseById.get(location.warehouseId)?.name ?? "",
    }))));
});

router.get("/google-places/config", (_req, res): void => {
  res.json(GetGooglePlacesConfigResponse.parse({
    enabled: googlePlacesEnabled(),
    browserKey: googlePlacesEnabled() ? process.env.GOOGLE_MAPS_BROWSER_KEY : null,
  }));
});

router.get("/google-places/suggestions", async (req, res): Promise<void> => {
  const parsed = ListGooglePlaceSuggestionsQueryParams.safeParse(req.query);
  if (!parsed.success || parsed.data.query.trim().length < 3) { res.status(400).json({ error: "Enter at least three characters (up to 120) to search." }); return; }
  limitGoogleRequests(res.locals.ownerId as string);
  res.json(ListGooglePlaceSuggestionsResponse.parse(await suggestGooglePlaces(parsed.data.query.trim())));
});

router.post("/google-places/resolve", async (req, res): Promise<void> => {
  const parsed = ResolveGooglePlaceBody.safeParse(req.body);
  if (!parsed.success || Number(Boolean(parsed.data?.placeId)) + Number(Boolean(parsed.data?.pin)) !== 1) {
    res.status(400).json({ error: "Choose either a Google place or a pin." });
    return;
  }
  limitGoogleRequests(res.locals.ownerId as string);
  const place = parsed.data.placeId
    ? await resolveGooglePlace(parsed.data.placeId)
    : await resolveGooglePin(parsed.data.pin!);
  res.json(ResolveGooglePlaceResponse.parse(place));
});

router.post("/locations", async (req, res): Promise<void> => {
  const parsed = CreateLocationBody.safeParse(req.body);
  if (!parsed.success) {
    res.status(400).json({ error: parsed.error.message });
    return;
  }
  validateCoordinatePair(parsed.data.latitude, parsed.data.longitude);
  if (parsed.data.googlePlaceId && parsed.data.googlePin) throw new InventoryError("Choose either a Google place or a map pin.");
  const ownerId = res.locals.ownerId as string;
  const warehouse = await warehouseById(ownerId, parsed.data.warehouseId);
  if (!warehouse) throw new InventoryError("Choose a warehouse in your inventory.");
  await requireValidParent(ownerId, parsed.data.parentId, warehouse.id);
  // Never trust a client-supplied address/coordinates for a Google selection.
  if (parsed.data.googlePlaceId || parsed.data.googlePin) limitGoogleRequests(ownerId);
  const googlePlace = parsed.data.googlePlaceId
    ? await resolveGooglePlace(parsed.data.googlePlaceId)
    : parsed.data.googlePin ? await resolveGooglePin(parsed.data.googlePin) : null;
  const [location] = await db.insert(locations).values({
    ownerId,
    name: parsed.data.name.trim(),
    code: parsed.data.code.trim().toUpperCase(),
    warehouseId: warehouse.id,
    parentId: parsed.data.parentId ?? null,
    kind: parsed.data.kind,
    address: googlePlace?.address ?? parsed.data.address?.trim() ?? null,
    latitude: googlePlace?.latitude ?? parsed.data.latitude ?? null,
    longitude: googlePlace?.longitude ?? parsed.data.longitude ?? null,
    googlePlaceId: googlePlace?.placeId ?? null,
  }).returning();
  res.status(201).json(CreateLocationResponse.parse({ ...location, warehouseName: warehouse.name }));
});

router.patch("/locations/:id", async (req, res): Promise<void> => {
  const params = UpdateLocationParams.safeParse(req.params);
  const parsed = UpdateLocationBody.safeParse(req.body);
  if (!params.success || !parsed.success) {
    res.status(400).json({ error: !params.success ? params.error.message : !parsed.success ? parsed.error.message : "Invalid request." });
    return;
  }
  validateCoordinatePair(parsed.data.latitude, parsed.data.longitude);
  const ownerId = res.locals.ownerId as string;
  const existing = await locationById(ownerId, params.data.id);
  if (!existing) {
    res.status(404).json({ error: "Location not found." });
    return;
  }
  await requireValidParent(ownerId, parsed.data.parentId, existing.warehouseId, existing.id);
  const addressChanged = parsed.data.address !== undefined && (parsed.data.address?.trim() ?? null) !== existing.address;
  const coordinatesChanged = (parsed.data.latitude !== undefined && parsed.data.latitude !== existing.latitude)
    || (parsed.data.longitude !== undefined && parsed.data.longitude !== existing.longitude);
  const [location] = await db.update(locations).set({
    ...parsed.data,
    ...(parsed.data.name !== undefined ? { name: parsed.data.name.trim() } : {}),
    ...(parsed.data.code !== undefined ? { code: parsed.data.code.trim().toUpperCase() } : {}),
    ...(parsed.data.address !== undefined ? { address: parsed.data.address?.trim() ?? null } : {}),
    ...(addressChanged && parsed.data.latitude === undefined ? { latitude: null, longitude: null } : {}),
    ...(addressChanged || coordinatesChanged ? { googlePlaceId: null } : {}),
  }).where(and(eq(locations.ownerId, ownerId), eq(locations.id, existing.id))).returning();
  const warehouse = await warehouseById(ownerId, existing.warehouseId);
  res.json(UpdateLocationResponse.parse({ ...location, warehouseName: warehouse?.name ?? "" }));
});

router.delete("/locations/:id", async (req, res): Promise<void> => {
  const params = DeleteLocationParams.safeParse(req.params);
  if (!params.success) {
    res.status(400).json({ error: params.error.message });
    return;
  }
  const ownerId = res.locals.ownerId as string;
  const id = params.data.id;
  const [stock, child, operation, defaultProduct, stockHistory] = await Promise.all([
    db.select({ id: balances.id }).from(balances).where(and(eq(balances.ownerId, ownerId), eq(balances.locationId, id))).limit(1),
    db.select({ id: locations.id }).from(locations).where(and(eq(locations.ownerId, ownerId), eq(locations.parentId, id))).limit(1),
    db.select({ id: operations.id }).from(operations).where(and(eq(operations.ownerId, ownerId), or(eq(operations.sourceLocationId, id), eq(operations.destinationLocationId, id)))).limit(1),
    db.select({ id: products.id }).from(products).where(and(
      eq(products.ownerId, ownerId),
      eq(products.defaultLocationId, id),
      eq(products.active, true),
    )).limit(1),
    db.select({ id: stockMoves.id }).from(stockMoves).where(and(
      eq(stockMoves.ownerId, ownerId),
      or(eq(stockMoves.sourceLocationId, id), eq(stockMoves.destinationLocationId, id)),
    )).limit(1),
  ]);
  if (stockHistory.length) {
    res.status(409).json({ error: "This location has stock history and cannot be deleted." });
    return;
  }
  if (stock.length || child.length || operation.length || defaultProduct.length) {
    res.status(409).json({ error: "This location is used by stock, another location, an operation, or an active product's default location." });
    return;
  }
  const [deleted] = await db.delete(locations)
    .where(and(eq(locations.ownerId, ownerId), eq(locations.id, id)))
    .returning({ id: locations.id });
  if (!deleted) {
    res.status(404).json({ error: "Location not found." });
    return;
  }
  res.sendStatus(204);
});

export default router;
